rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT + phonon workflow on 2D materials with GGA, double-zeta basis, and norm-conserving pseudopotentials; no custom theory or equation derivation beyond known formulas.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline: geometry optimization of two sheets, isolated atom energy, two phonon calculations, each with SIESTA input file generation and post-processing. Requires installation and invocation of SIESTA and Phonopy, but steps are linear and well-documented.

The methods (geometry relaxation, binding energy formula, finite-displacement phonon calculation with rotational symmetry enforcement) are well-established in the field and do not require novel algorithm design. The pipeline involves a few sequential compute stages using standard tools (SIESTA, Phonopy), but orchestration is simple and data are tiny. Resources are minimal: small unit cells (2-8 atoms) on a single CPU node.
